name: Wax London
why: Textured casual clothing — corduroy, bouclé, heavy cotton — made in Portugal; the Whiting overshirt is its best-known piece.
origin: Founded in London in the mid-2010s; grew from market stalls into department-store wholesale.

notes.cotton: corduroy and heavy cotton — the texture-first thesis
notes.craft: PDPs state a country of make (China, Tunisia, Morocco) and composition; only one product names a mill (Deveaux, France). No factories named anywhere and nothing owned. Country-of-make plus one mill name is a 2.
notes.whitet: sells a tee as a basic (price pass); not read for more — seeded 27 Sep 2026, provisional
